item.title: Lyndsey Grein, Elise Sokolsky return to headline Oregon softball pitching staff
item.description: The pitching staff that led the Ducks to a Women’s College World Series appearance last season remains largely intact in 2026, with promising depth options in tow. Oregon’s battle-tested tandem of senior Lyndsey Grein and redshirt senior Elise Sokolsky, who totaled 190.1 and 151 innings, respectively, last season, will face a similar workload in 2026....
